title: Towards Harmless Multimodal Assistants with Blind Preference Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating 'modality cheating' by comparing model responses to multimodal instructions versus text-only instructions (blinding the model) to measure the model's over-reliance on safety-related textual patterns and its disregard for visual information.

Measuring the safety rate and pairwise accuracy of MLLM responses using the MMSafe-PO dataset and MM-SafetyBench, which include specific hierarchical categories for representation harms, toxicity, and hate speech.
